lines.en: label ayanespecial55:
scene ayanegamenight1
: Oh! Oh! What is the “echidna!”
lines.zh: : 哦！哦！“针鼹”是什么！

lines.en: : What {i}is{/i} the echidna? It sounds made up.
lines.zh: : 针鼹{i}是{/i}什么？听起来像是编出来的。

lines.en: : Apparently, it is an egg-laying mammal without teeth. As for why Ayane knows that, I have no idea. But she’s gotten more than half of these questions correct so far, so I’m not exactly surprised.
lines.zh: : 据说是一种卵生、没有牙齿的哺乳动物。至于 Ayane 为什么会知道这个，我完全不清楚。不过到目前为止这些问题她答对了一大半，所以我也不算太意外。

lines.en: It’s another Saturday night at my place. And for the first time in what feels like forever, the three girls I hold closest to my heart are together and bonding.
lines.zh: 又是一个在我家的周六夜晚。而且在感觉上像是过了很久之后，我最珍视的三个女生第一次聚在了一起，正在培养感情。

lines.en: And I use the word “bonding” loosely because the majority of the night has consisted of them shouting words at my television and keeping the neighbors that I probably have awake.
lines.zh: “培养感情”这个词我用得很宽松，因为这大半个晚上她们都在冲着我的电视大吼大叫，把我大概存在的邻居们吵得睡不着。

lines.en: Come to think of it, it’s a little strange that I’ve never once interacted with anyone in any of the surrounding houses. But I guess it’s probably better off that way.
lines.zh: 想想看，我从来没有跟周围任何一栋房子里的任何人打过交道，这确实有点奇怪。不过我想这样也许更好。

lines.en: The fewer people I know, the better.
lines.zh: 我认识的人越少越好。

lines.en: Unless, of course, those people are attractive (And likely pubescent) teenage girls who dream of riding my penis. But, I repeat, I’m probably better off not knowing them for reasons I’m sure you can understand.
lines.zh: 当然，除非那些人是梦想着骑上我阴茎的、迷人的（而且大概正值青春期的）少女。不过我再说一遍，不认识她们大概对我更好，理由我相信你能理解。

lines.en: As for these ones, though...I’m glad I {i}do{/i} know them.
lines.zh: 至于这几位呢……我庆幸自己{i}认识{/i}她们。

lines.en: Knowing Ami is inevitable given our blood relation and whatnot. But I can’t even fathom what life without Maya or Ayane would be like.
lines.zh: 认识 Ami 是必然的，毕竟我们有血缘关系什么的。可我甚至无法想象没有 Maya 或 Ayane 的人生会是什么样。

lines.en: On one hand, I’d have a lot more free time — and I’d never have to worry about things like the size of the moon or where to put my hands when hugging on a rooftop.
lines.zh: 一方面，我会有更多空闲时间——而且永远不用操心月亮的大小，或者在天台上拥抱时手该放在哪里这种事。

lines.en: But, on the other, I’d lack the household harem that has provided me so much comfort when you strip away all of the anguish that rides in on their shoulders.
lines.zh: 但另一方面，我就会失去这个家里的后宫——只要把压在她们肩上的那些痛苦剥掉，它一直给了我莫大的慰藉。

lines.en: I am home. In more ways than one.
lines.zh: 我在家。而且在好几层意义上。

lines.en: And I intend to stay here for as long as I can.
lines.zh: 只要能，我就打算一直待在这儿。

lines.en: Because these days, while uncertain and burdensome-
lines.zh: 因为这些日子，尽管充满不确定、又沉重——

lines.en: Are the best days I have ever had.
lines.zh: 却是我有生以来最好的日子。

lines.en: Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美这一切。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight2
: Can we maybe play something else soon? I’m starting to get a little tired of Ayane’s weird internal bank of useless knowledge.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能快点换点别的玩？我开始有点受不了 Ayane 那个装着无用知识的奇怪脑内银行了。

lines.en: : It clearly isn’t useless if it’s coming in handy tonight, right? Without my weird internal bank thingy, we’d just be watching some old guy on the TV ask a bunch of questions none of us know the answers to.
lines.zh: : 既然今晚派上了用场，那它显然就不是无用的，对吧？要没有我这个奇怪的脑内银行，我们就只能看着电视上某个老头问一堆我们谁都不知道答案的问题。

lines.en: : What is “Sirius.”
lines.zh: : “天狼星”是什么。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight3
: Like the radio? What was the question? I might have actually known that one.
lines.zh: : 像那个电台？题目到底是什么来着？那个我可能还真知道。

lines.en: : This star, in Canis Majoris, is the brightest in the night sky.
lines.zh: : 这颗位于大犬座的恒星，是夜空中最亮的。

lines.en: : The heck does that have to do with the radio?
lines.zh: : 那跟电台有什么关系啊？

lines.en: : Wow, Ami. You’re {i}seriously{/i} bad at this game, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇，Ami。你玩这个游戏是{i}真的{/i}烂，是吧？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight4
: Get it? Like...{i}Sirius.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听懂了吗？就像……{i}Sirius{/i}（seriously）。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m going to sleep.
lines.zh: : 好。我要去睡了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I’ve also reached my horrible joke limit for the night. And every single one of them just so happened to come from Ayane.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想我也到达了今晚烂笑话的极限。而且每一个都恰好出自 Ayane 之口。

lines.en: : Don’t hate the player, Maya. Hate the game.
lines.zh: : 别恨玩家，Maya。要恨就恨游戏。

lines.en: : I hate the game. We’re playing Wii Sports next sleepover and I don’t care what anyone says.
lines.zh: : 我恨这个游戏。下次过夜派对我们玩 Wii Sports，谁说都不好使。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight5
: But, on that note, I guess it’s time we take baths. It’s getting pretty late anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过说到这个，我想我们该去洗澡了。反正也挺晚了。

lines.en: : I feel like that’s a thing we should have done {i}before{/i} putting our pajamas on. This was not an effective order of operations.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这事儿应该在换上睡衣{i}之前{/i}做。这个操作顺序效率不高。

lines.en: : You two can go ahead. I’ll hang out here with Sensei in the meantime and finish up Jeopardy with him.
lines.zh: : 你们俩先去吧。我留在这儿陪 Sensei，跟他把《危险边缘》看完。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight6
: Oh! Instead of that, how about {i}I-{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦！要不这样，{i}我{/i}来——

lines.en: : Nope! You can go on ahead, Ami. I’m perfectly capable of hanging out in the living room without making love to your uncle. I’ve been doing it for years.
lines.zh: : 不行！你先去吧，Ami。我完全有能力在客厅里待着而不跟你舅舅做爱。这事我已经干了好多年了。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: Come to think of it, I guess we {i}haven’t{/i} had sex in the living room yet.
lines.zh: 想想看，我们好像{i}还没{/i}在客厅里做过。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight7
: Uhh...
: You do know that all three of us should be able to- never mind. I just realized what’s going on here. But good luck getting Ami to agree to-
lines.zh: : 你该知道我们三个应该都能——算了。我刚反应过来这是怎么回事了。不过祝你能说服 Ami 同意——

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight8
: {i}Hah...{/i}fine.
: Wait, seriously? You’re not going to, like...sew your skin to Sensei’s or tie him up and drag him into the bathroom with us?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的假的？你不打算……比如把你的皮肤缝在 Sensei 身上，或者把他绑起来一起拖进浴室？

lines.en: : No...I’m pretty sure those things fall under “suffocating” and I told Sensei I’d be good from now on. Let’s just go take our stupid bath without Ayane.
lines.zh: : 不……我敢肯定那些事属于“窒息”的范畴，而且我跟 Sensei 说过从现在起会乖一点。我们就别管 Ayane，去洗那个破澡吧。

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : What’s going on is Ami is learning to be less clingy and we should all be very proud of her! Hooray for Ami!
lines.zh: : 事情是这样的：Ami 正在学着不要太黏人，我们都该为她感到骄傲！Ami 万岁！

lines.en: scene black
: Hooray my butt! You know darn well I’m doing this against my will. Come on, Maya.
lines.zh: : 万岁个屁！你心里清楚得很，我这么做根本不是自愿的。走了，Maya。

lines.en: : You don’t have, like...surveillance cameras anywhere, do you? Because I can’t imagine any other reason you’d so easily accept-
lines.zh: : 你该不会在什么地方装了……监控摄像头吧？因为我想不出还有什么别的理由能让你这么轻易就接受——

lines.en: : I said come on!
lines.zh: : 我说了走了！

lines.en: : Jesus, chill. The bath’s not even warm yet.
lines.zh: : 天哪，冷静点。洗澡水都还没热呢。

lines.en: : Sensei! Couch!
lines.zh: : Sensei！沙发！

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight9
Ami and Maya head into the bathroom and, in between wondering why it’s totally normal for girls to do things like this, I find a moment to savor this newfound peace and quiet.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 走进浴室，我一边纳闷为什么女生做这种事完全正常，一边找了个片刻，享受这份来之不易的宁静。

lines.en: But that’s not without the mildly worrying caveat that there must have been some sort of catalyst needed to get here.
lines.zh: 但这其中也带着一点令人担心的前提：走到这一步，一定需要某种催化剂。

lines.en: I know Ami better than anyone. Even more so than Maya and Ayane. So why is it that Ayane is suddenly able to seize me without any sort of repercussion?
lines.zh: 我比任何人都了解 Ami。甚至超过 Maya 和 Ayane。那为什么 Ayane 突然能毫无后果地把我占为己有？

lines.en: This can’t just be the result of Ami actually taking my words to heart, can it?
lines.zh: 这不可能只是因为 Ami 真的把我的话听进去了，对吧？

lines.en: I’ve said plenty of {i}words{/i} to her since waking up in my own body again, and her heart has gone entirely unchanged up to this point in time.
lines.zh: 自从我重新在自己的身体里醒来，我已经对她说了很多{i}话{/i}，可到目前为止，她的心没有丝毫改变。

lines.en: Maybe she’s like me?
lines.zh: 也许她跟我一样？

lines.en: Finally changing.
lines.zh: 终于开始改变了。

lines.en: Finally attempting to look forward instead of glancing over her shoulder every five seconds.
lines.zh: 终于试着向前看，而不是每五秒就回头张望一次。

lines.en: Or maybe it’s something else?
lines.zh: 或者也许是别的原因？

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: All I know is that, whatever it is...might just be the single most worrying thing I’ve ever seen from my beloved niece.
lines.zh: 我只知道，不管那是什么……这可能是我从我亲爱的侄女身上见过的最让人担心的一件事。

lines.en: Who would never hurt anyone.
lines.zh: 她绝不会伤害任何人。

lines.en: : I missed you.
lines.zh: : 我想你了。

lines.en: Who would never hurt anyone.
lines.zh: 她绝不会伤害任何人。

lines.en: : I’m glad to be back.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴自己回来了。

lines.en: Especially me.
lines.zh: 尤其不会伤害我。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “back?” You haven’t gone anywhere.
lines.zh: : “回来”是什么意思？你哪儿都没去啊。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight10
: Maybe not {i}physically.{/i} But mentally, I’ve been in a pretty bad place for a while now. And I’m just starting to snap myself out of it.
lines.zh: : {i}身体上{/i}是没去哪儿。但精神上，我已经在很糟的地方待了好一阵子了。而现在我才刚开始把自己从里面拽出来。

lines.en: : Things like that wouldn’t happen if you’d stop being such a martyr, you know.
lines.zh: : 你要不是这么爱当殉道者，这种事就不会发生了，你知道吧。

lines.en: : Martyrs die. And I’m not going anywhere ever again.
lines.zh: : 殉道者会死。而我再也不会去任何地方了。

lines.en: : None of us are. None of us {i}can.{/i} What I meant is that you’d have less mental voyages if you’d get better at talking about your problems.
lines.zh: : 我们都不会。我们谁都{i}去不了{/i}。我的意思是，如果你能更擅长说出自己的烦恼，精神上的神游就会少一些。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight11
: That’s really funny. Coming from you, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这话真好笑。我是说，从你嘴里说出来。

lines.en: : I’m aware that I could benefit from the same thing. I’m just too caught up in my ways at this point.
lines.zh: : 我知道我也一样能从中受益。只是到了这个地步，我已经太积习难改了。

lines.en: : You and Maya both. Kudos to me for being the mature and logical one in the group. I bet nobody saw that coming.
lines.zh: : 你和 Maya 都一样。恭喜我成了这群人里成熟又讲逻辑的那个。我敢说没人料得到。

lines.en: : Careful or Makoto might gun for your position. I’m pretty sure her biggest fetish is {i}logic.{/i}
lines.zh: : 小心点，不然 Makoto 可能会来抢你的位置。我敢说她最大的癖好就是{i}逻辑{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you think she’ll still be “around” after the next reset? Or do you think she’ll go back to not knowing how any of this stuff works?
lines.zh: : 你觉得下次重置之后她还会“在”吗？还是说她会回到对这些事一无所知的状态？

lines.en: : None of us know how any of this stuff works. Which includes me not having any clue what will or won’t happen to Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我们谁都不知道这些东西是怎么运作的。其中也包括我完全不知道 Makoto 会或不会发生什么。

lines.en: : I’m just trying not to get my hopes up. I did that with Yumi and Tsuneyo and that didn’t pan out how any of us wanted. So expecting nothing will-
lines.zh: : 我只是尽量不去抱太大希望。我在 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 身上抱过，结果完全不像我们任何人想要的那样。所以什么都不指望——

lines.en: : Be the best way to avoid getting hurt. You’re right.
lines.zh: : 是避免受伤的最好办法。你说得对。

lines.en: : I’m doing the same thing. Or...trying to, at least.
lines.zh: : 我也在做同样的事。或者……至少在试着做。

lines.en: : The problem with hope is that it always finds its way in whether you want it to or not. And there’s no way any of us could be, like...immune to that.
lines.zh: : 希望的问题在于，不管你想不想，它总能找到缝隙钻进来。而我们谁都不可能……对它免疫。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight12
: You seem a little...{i}reflective{/i} tonight. Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 你今晚看起来有点……{i}若有所思{/i}。发生什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Of course something happened. I’m not nearly strong enough to break free from inner turmoil without {i}something{/i} causing it.
lines.zh: : 当然发生了什么。我可没有坚强到不需要{i}外因{/i}就能自己从内心挣扎里脱身。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re giving yourself enough credit, Ayane. You’re one of the strongest people I know.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你太看轻自己了，Ayane。你是我认识的最坚强的人之一。

lines.en: : And I just got a whole lot stronger.
lines.zh: : 而且我刚刚变得更强了。

lines.en: : Meaning...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 意思是……到底是什么？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight13

: Unfortunately, I promised I wouldn’t tell you. It’s nothing but good news, though. For me, definitely. And...for {i}all{/i} of us, I think. But that last part is more of an expectation than actually {i}knowing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可惜我答应过不说。不过这完全是好消息。对我是，肯定的。而且……对我们{i}大家{/i}都是，我想。但最后那部分与其说是{i}知道{/i}，不如说是期待。

lines.en: : So...you’re just going to tell me you had some intense inner struggle that you’ve now recovered from, but won’t provide any of the details and I have to just...go along with it?
lines.zh: : 所以……你就打算告诉我，你经历了一场激烈的内心挣扎、现在已经恢复了，却一个细节都不肯说，而我就得……这么顺着你？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Well, that’s fun.
lines.zh: : 行吧，真有意思。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight14
: Trust me when I say that hearing the details would just make things even more confusing. And that’s exactly what I’m trying to {i}avoid{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 相信我，听了细节只会让事情更混乱。而这正是我现在想{i}避免{/i}的。

lines.en: : We’ve been looking at things all wrong. Worrying about {i}how{/i} things work instead of {i}why{/i} the world is like this.
lines.zh: : 我们一直把事情看反了。一直在操心事情是{i}怎么{/i}运作的，而不是这个世界{i}为什么{/i}是这样的。

lines.en: : Do you know {i}why{/i} the world is like this, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你知道这个世界{i}为什么{/i}是这样吗，Ayane？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight15
: What I know is that I love you.
lines.zh: : 我知道的是，我爱你。

lines.en: : {i}Everyone{/i} knows that. It’s not exactly a revelation.
lines.zh: : 这{i}谁都{/i}知道。算不上什么新发现。

lines.en: : No. But it’ll be my crutch again as both of us begin a new chapter of our lives.
lines.zh: : 不。但当我和你一起翻开人生的新篇章时，它会再次成为我的拐杖。

lines.en: : And that chapter is what?
lines.zh: : 那一章是什么？

lines.en: : One without fear.
lines.zh: : 没有恐惧的一章。

lines.en: : One where {i}we{/i} come first and the world comes second.
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}排第一，世界排第二的一章。

lines.en: : I have eternity to spend with you. That’s lifetimes and lifetimes worth of happiness and laughter and the backwards spider crawl.
lines.zh: : 我有一整个永恒可以跟你一起度过。那是好几辈子又好几辈子的幸福、欢笑，还有倒着爬的蜘蛛爬。

lines.en: : I still haven’t figured out what that is.
lines.zh: : 我到现在都没搞懂那是什么。

lines.en: : Neither have I. But the point is that we can figure it out {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也没有。但重点是我们能{i}一起{/i}弄明白。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what you’re saying, Ayane. Is this, like...a resignation from the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad?
lines.zh: : 我不太确定你在说什么，Ayane。这算是……退出“天台末日小队”吗？

lines.en: : It sounds kind of weird hearing you call it that.
lines.zh: : 听你这么叫，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : It feels kind of weird saying it.
lines.zh: : 说出来也怪怪的。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m not resigning from anything. And I’m honestly not sure if I even {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei，我没有要退出任何东西。而且说实话，我也不确定自己退不{i}退得掉{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ll still be on that roof with you and Maya. And maybe Makoto. But it’ll be a better me.
lines.zh: : 我依然会跟你、跟 Maya 一起站在那个天台上。也许还有 Makoto。但那会是一个更好的我。

lines.en: : I’ll be an Ayane you can lean on.
lines.zh: : 我会成为一个你可以依靠的 Ayane。

lines.en: : And I’ll protect you from anything and everything that would ever want to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 而且我会保护你，不让任何想要伤害你的东西靠近你。

lines.en: : Do you...know something that might want to hurt me?
lines.zh: : 你……知道有什么东西想要伤害我吗？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight16
: Other than yourself? It’s hard to say. But...let me ask you this.
lines.zh: : 除了你自己之外？很难说。不过……让我问你一个问题。

lines.en: : What do you think of the way Ami’s been acting lately?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Ami 最近的表现怎么样？

lines.en: : Honestly?...
lines.zh: : 说实话？……

lines.en: : It’s concerning.
lines.zh: : 挺让人担心的。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight17
: Isn’t it? She seems all cute and cuddly on the outside, but she can be a real {i}monster{/i} on the inside sometimes, can’t she?
lines.zh: : 是吧？她外表看起来又可爱又黏人，可内心有时候真是个{i}怪物{/i}，不是吗？

lines.en: : She’s doing it out of love, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她这么做是出于爱。

lines.en: : Is that what you actually think? Or is it something she’s just said so many times now that you can’t help but accept it as truth?
lines.zh: : 你真这么想吗？还是说，只是因为她说了太多次，你才不由自主地把它当成了事实？

lines.en: : It’s what I actually think. But a better question is what happened between you two where she’s suddenly no longer combative against your attempts to steal alone time with me?
lines.zh: : 我真这么想。不过更好的问题是，你们俩之间发生了什么，让她突然不再抗拒你偷走跟我独处的时间了？

lines.en: : I did what any friend would do. I talked to her.
lines.zh: : 我做了任何朋友都会做的事。我跟她谈了谈。

lines.en: : I called her out on all of the things she does that piss me off and I told her I wouldn’t stand for them anymore.
lines.zh: : 我把她所有惹毛我的行为都当面指了出来，还告诉她我再也不会忍了。

lines.en: : And she just...accepted that?
lines.zh: : 而她就……接受了？

lines.en: : Only time will tell.
lines.zh: : 只有时间能证明。

lines.en: : But I have a good feeling she did.
lines.zh: : 不过我有种好预感，她接受了。

lines.en: : And I have a good feeling she won’t be getting in the way of us as much as she used to.
lines.zh: : 而且我有种好预感，她不会再像以前那样挡在我们中间了。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight18
: Well...I hope you’re right. About everything.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我希望你是对的。在所有事情上。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’ll be able to just stop worrying about stuff the way you have...but whatever it is that’s helped you feel better, whether that be your talk with Ami or anything else that may have happened...
lines.zh: : 我不确定自己能不能像你一样，说放下就放下那些忧虑……不过不管是什么让你感觉好起来了，是你跟 Ami 的那次谈话也好，可能发生的其他事也好……

lines.en: : I’m glad.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴。

lines.en: : I missed the happier version of you.
lines.zh: : 我想念那个更快乐的你了。

lines.en: : Same here. Life’s been on a constant downward spiral ever since that half-year stretch where we weren’t allowed to have sex. I’m glad things are finally turning around.
lines.zh: : 我也是。自从那半年不准我们做爱之后，人生就一直在螺旋下坠。我很高兴事情终于开始好转了。

lines.en: : And also, we should have sex.
lines.zh: : 还有，我们应该做爱。

lines.en: : Like...Like {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 比如……比如{i}现在{/i}？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight19
: Don’t know. Think my new sway with Ami will get her to agree to the two of {i}us{/i} taking a bath together next?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你觉得我现在跟 Ami 的新关系，能让她同意下次{i}我们俩{/i}一起洗澡吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if there’s anything in the world that could get her to agree to that...
lines.zh: : 我不确定这世上有什么能让她同意那种事……

lines.en: scene black
: Neither am I.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定。

lines.en: : But just this is enough for now.
lines.zh: : 不过现在这样就够了。

lines.en: : Even if I know she hates it.
lines.zh: : 哪怕我知道她讨厌这样。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight20
: That gosh darn bubblewrap princess. She’s lucky I’m in such a good mood tonight.
lines.zh: : 那个该死的泡泡纸公主。算她走运，我今晚心情好。

lines.en: : Question. Why {i}are{/i} you in such a good mood tonight? That was the least...{i}aggressive{/i} I’ve ever seen you when it comes to cock-blocking Sensei.
lines.zh: : 问你个问题。你今晚为什么心情这么好？在阻止 Sensei 得手这件事上，我可从没见过你这么不……{i}激进{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight21
: Don’t call it that. Calling it that makes it sound like the two of them are getting up to no good out there.
lines.zh: : 别说得这么难听。这么说听起来就像他们两个在外面干坏事似的。

lines.en: : For all we know, they are. They’re both insatiable. I wouldn’t put it past them.
lines.zh: : 说不定他们就是。他们俩都欲求不满。这种事我信他们干得出来。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight22
: Sensei is not {i}insatiable.{/i} He’s just a pervert with unsophisticated taste. Or...sophisticated taste if it’s in relation to me. But it’s normally not, so...
lines.zh: : Sensei 才不是{i}欲求不满{/i}。他只是个品味不高明的变态。或者……如果是跟我有关的话，品味很高明。但通常不是，所以……

lines.en: : He’s just a pervert.
lines.zh: : 他只是个变态。

lines.en: : If that’s what helps you sleep at night, Ami.
lines.zh: : 如果这么说能让你晚上睡得着的话，Ami。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight23
: What about you, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，Maya？

lines.en: : What {i}about{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 我{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : I mean...how do {i}you{/i} feel about Ayane getting to spend alone time with Sensei while the two of us are stuck in here?
lines.zh: : 我是说……Ayane 能跟 Sensei 独处，而我们俩困在这儿，{i}你{/i}什么感觉？

lines.en: : Um...normal?
lines.zh: : 嗯……正常？

lines.en: : You’re not even a little jealous?
lines.zh: : 你一点都不吃醋？

lines.en: : What would I have to be jealous of?
lines.zh: : 我有什么好吃醋的？

lines.en: : The pervy stuff that might be happening.
lines.zh: : 可能正在发生的那些色色的事啊。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight24
: I couldn’t be any less interested in that sort of thing if I tried.
lines.zh: : 就算我努力，也不可能对那种事更没兴趣了。

lines.en: : You can be honest with me, Maya. I won’t get mad. I’ve already accepted that everyone in our class is constantly fantasizing about Sensei because he’s the perfect man.
lines.zh: : 你可以对我诚实的，Maya。我不会生气。我已经接受了，我们班每个人都在不停地幻想 Sensei，因为他是完美男人。

lines.en: : You have an expectedly horrid definition of the word “perfect.”
lines.zh: : 你对“完美”这个词的定义，糟糕得不出所料。

lines.en: : As long as it’s just fantasy, you can do whatever you want. It’s only when it becomes real that it’s a problem.
lines.zh: : 只要停留在幻想里，你想怎么想都行。只有变成现实才是问题。

lines.en: : You could even think of me if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想的话，甚至可以想着我。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight25
: Okay, seriously, what is going on with you? You’ve been weird ever since we got back from the beach.
lines.zh: : 好了，说真的，你到底怎么了？从海边回来之后你就一直怪怪的。

lines.en: : And Ayane hasn’t?
lines.zh: : 那 Ayane 不怪吗？

lines.en: : You {i}both{/i} have. But Ayane hasn’t outright told me that she wouldn’t care if I sexually fantasized about her.
lines.zh: : 你们{i}两个都{/i}怪。但 Ayane 至少没直白地跟我说过，她不在乎我用性幻想意淫她。

lines.en: : It probably just hasn’t come up yet.
lines.zh: : 大概只是还没聊到而已。

lines.en: : And it probably won’t because it’s weird.
lines.zh: : 大概永远也不会聊到，因为那很奇怪。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}that{/i} weird. What {i}is{/i} weird is how sexually open our entire class seems to be despite all of us being teenage girls. Or how every single one of us is absolutely adorable.
lines.zh: : 也没{i}那么{/i}奇怪。奇怪的{i}是{/i}，明明我们都是十几岁的女生，我们整个班却对性这么开放。或者是我们每一个都可爱得要命。

lines.en: : Or how our class has its own dorm building. Or how the weather suddenly isn’t as hot as it’s supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 或者是我们班居然有一栋专属的宿舍楼。或者是天气突然没该有的那么热了。

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight26
: Or how the sidewalk just ends and drops off into nothing sometimes, but no one ever says anything about it.
lines.zh: : 或者是人行道有时候会突然断掉、下面空空如也，却从来没有人提起过。

lines.en: : There are millions of things we can see that we don’t speak of because it would ruin something bigger.
lines.zh: : 有成千上万件我们看得见、却绝口不提的事，因为说出来会毁掉某个更大的东西。

lines.en: : Ami...what are-
lines.zh: : Ami……你到底——

lines.en: : It’s only when it becomes real that it’s a problem. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 只有变成现实才是问题。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Only when...
lines.zh: : 只有变成……

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i} I have no idea what you’re trying to-
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}？我完全不知道你想说——

lines.en: : Just keep it all a fantasy...okay?
lines.zh: : 就让一切停留在幻想里……好吗？

lines.en: : Can you do that?
lines.zh: : 你能做到吗？

lines.en: scene ayanegamenight27
: Could you let me go now? I’d kind of like to pay a visit to the other side of the bath.
lines.zh: : 你能先放开我吗？我有点想去浴缸的另一边。

lines.en: : But I’ll get lonely if you’re gone.
lines.zh: : 可你走了我会寂寞的。

lines.en: : Then...get lonely. You’re weirding me out.
lines.zh: : 那就……寂寞着吧。你把我搞得很不舒服。

lines.en: scene black
: Psht...fine. And here I was thinking we were about to have a cute bonding session.
lines.zh: : 切……行吧。我还以为我们终于要有一次可爱的交心时刻了呢。

lines.en: : We can bond from opposite ends of the bath...
lines.zh: : 我们可以在浴缸的两端交心……
